license_required.quote: The board shall issue a license to engage in the practice of public accounting to an individual who meets the requirements of AS 08.04.110 - 08.04.130.

issuing_authority.quote: "board" means the Board of Public Accountancy

moral_character_required.quote: An applicant for a certified public accountant license shall be of good moral character.

degree_required.value: baccalaureate degree plus 150 total semester hours
degree_required.quote: a baccalaureate degree or its equivalent conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board and additional semester hours or post-baccalaureate study so that the total educational program includes at least 150 hours

required.quote: two years of accounting experience satisfactory to the board

duration.quote: two years of accounting experience satisfactory to the board

kind.quote: two years of accounting experience satisfactory to the board

exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Administered by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants; board uses AICPA advisory grading service if available.
exams.quote: The board shall use the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants and the institute's advisory grading service, if available.

interval_years.quote: The license is valid for the remainder of the biennial licensing period during which the initial license was granted.

required.quote: The board shall by regulation prescribe requirements for continuing education for individuals with licenses under this chapter.

period_years.quote: satisfaction of the continuing education requirements prescribed by the board during the two years immediately preceding the application

available.quote: the board may issue a license to engage in the practice of public accounting to an applicant who holds a license, or its equivalent, issued by another state

requirements.value: Applicant must have passed the Uniform CPA Examination for their initial license, meet experience requirements set by board regulation, not be subject to pending disciplinary proceedings, and be of good moral character.
requirements.quote: passed the Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants in order to receive the applicant's initial license from the other state; meets the accounting experience requirements established by the board by regulation; is not the subject of review procedures, disciplinary proceedings, or unresolved complaints related to the applicant's license from another state; and is of good moral character.

regulatory_model.quote: The board shall issue a license to engage in the practice of public accounting to an individual who meets the requirements of AS 08.04.110 - 08.04.130.

title_protection.quote: An individual may not assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, word, letter, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the individual is a certified public accountant, unless the individual has received a license

scope_protection.quote: Only a person who holds a valid license, practice privilege, or permit may issue a report on behalf of another person or governmental unit.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining a license or permit required by this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fraud or deceit in obtaining a license or permit required by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty or gross negligence in the practice of public accounting, or other acts discreditable to the accounting profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: dishonesty or gross negligence in the practice of public accounting, or other acts discreditable to the accounting profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a provision of AS 08.04.500–08.04.610 or failure to take corrective action regarding firm ownership noncompliance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of a provision of AS 08.04.500 - 08.04.610 or failure to take corrective action to comply with AS 08.04.240(i) within the time allowed under AS 08.04.240(j)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a rule of professional conduct or other regulation adopted by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of a rule of professional conduct or other regulation adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony under the laws of any state or of the United States.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a felony under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime whose essential element is dishonesty or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of any crime, an essential element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of any state or of the United States

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a CPA or public accountant in any other state for cause other than nonpayment of fees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as a certified public accountant or public accountant in any other state for any cause other than failure to pay a required fee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to satisfy the continuing education requirements prescribed by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to satisfy the continuing education requirements prescribed by the board under AS 08.04.425

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the peer review requirement under AS 08.04.426.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with the peer review requirement under AS 08.04.426

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act in another state for which the licensee would be subject to discipline in this or the other state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commission of an act in another state for which the holder of the license, practice privilege, or permit would be subject to discipline in this or the other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, deceit, or gross negligence in the filing or failure to file the licensee's own income tax returns.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: dishonesty, fraud, deceit, or gross negligence by the holder of a license, practice privilege, or permit in the filing or failure to file the income tax returns of the holder of the license, practice privilege, or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license, practice privilege, or permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license, practice privilege, or permit under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: A false or misleading statement or verification provided in support of another person's application for a license or permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a false or misleading statement or verification provided in support of the application of another person for a license or permit under this chapter

definition_quote.value: the offering to perform or the performance as a person holding a license, practice privilege, or permit under this chapter of a service involving the use of accounting or auditing skills; in this paragraph, "accounting or auditing skills" includes preparing financial statements, issuing reports, furnishing management services, furnishing financial advisory services, providing consulting services, preparing tax returns, advising on tax matters, or consulting on tax matters
definition_quote.quote: "practice of public accounting" means the offering to perform or the performance as a person holding a license, practice privilege, or permit under this chapter of a service involving the use of accounting or auditing skills; in this paragraph, "accounting or auditing skills" includes preparing financial statements, issuing reports, furnishing management services, furnishing financial advisory services, providing consulting services, preparing tax returns, advising on tax matters, or consulting on tax matters

methods_authorized.quote: "accounting or auditing skills" includes preparing financial statements, issuing reports, furnishing management services, furnishing financial advisory services, providing consulting services, preparing tax returns, advising on tax matters, or consulting on tax matters

value: audit or other engagement established by Statements on Auditing Standards
review of a financial statement established by Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services
examination of prospective financial information established by Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements
engagement established by Auditing Standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board
examination, review, or agreed upon procedure under attestation engagement standards adopted by the board
attest_services_types.quote: "attest function" means (A) an audit or other engagement, if the performance of the audit or other engagement is established by the Statements on Auditing Standards; (B) a review of a financial statement, if the performance of the review is established by the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services; (C) an examination of prospective financial information, if the performance of the examination is established by the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements; (D) an engagement, if the performance of the engagement is established by the Auditing Standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "compilation service" means a service of any compilation engagement performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services

education_semester_hours_required.quote: total educational program includes at least 150 hours

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: An individual who may engage in the practice of public accounting in this state under (a) of this section is not required to provide a notice to the board, to pay a fee to the board, or to submit documentation to the board in order to engage in the practice of public accounting in this state.

value: consent to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
agree to comply with this chapter, including the regulations adopted by the board
agree to stop offering or engaging in the practice of public accounting if the license from the state of principal place of business becomes invalid
consent to the appointment of the state board that issued the individual's license as agent for service of process
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: consent to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; agree to comply with this chapter, including the regulations adopted by the board; agree that the individual or firm will stop offering to engage or engaging in the practice of public accounting, whether individually or on behalf of a firm, if the license from the state of the individual's or firm's principal place of business becomes invalid; and consent to the appointment of the state board that issued the individual's license as the individual's or firm's agent for service of process

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual licensed under AS 08.04.105 may not perform attest functions through a firm unless the firm holds a valid permit issued under AS 08.04.240.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: more than one-half of the ownership of the firm belongs to certified public accountants of this or another state in good standing

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: a firm may include owners who are not certified public accountants if (1) the firm designates a certified public accountant or an individual with practice privileges to be responsible for the proper registration of the entity

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board shall, not more frequently than once every three years, require as a condition for renewal of a permit of a firm that the applicant firm undergo a peer review conducted as required by the board by regulation.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: not more frequently than once every three years, require as a condition for renewal of a permit of a firm that the applicant firm undergo a peer review

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: a peer review be performed and the documents be maintained in a manner that is designed to preserve confidentiality

inactive_license_status_available.quote: an individual holding a license who is not engaged in the practice of public accounting may maintain the license in good standing by notifying the board that the individual is inactive and paying the required fee.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Each office established or maintained in this state for the practice of public accounting shall be under the direct supervision of an individual who holds a license issued under this chapter.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: an individual who is a certified public accountant or has a practice privilege, who is responsible for supervising attest functions or compilation services in the firm, and who signs or authorizes another person to sign an accountant's report on financial statements on behalf of the firm meets the competency requirements established by the board under AS 08.04.423

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: A license holder, a permit holder, or a practice privilege holder or a partner, an officer, a shareholder, a member, or an employee of a license holder, a permit holder, or a practice privilege holder may not reveal information communicated to the license holder, permit holder or practice privilege holder by a client about a matter concerning which the client has employed the license holder, permit holder, or practice privilege holder in a professional capacity.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: Statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a certified public accountant or a public accountant incident to or in the course of professional service to a client, except reports submitted to a client, are the property of the accountant, in the absence of an express agreement between the accountant and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: the following disclaimer language when used by a person without a license or practice privilege in connection with financial statements: "I (we) have prepared the accompanying (financial statements) of (name of entity) as of (time period) for the (period) then ended. This presentation is limited to preparing, in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management (owners)."

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: a holder of a certificate, license, or degree from a foreign country that entitles the holder to practice public accounting or the equivalent in the foreign country from providing professional services to the government of the country issuing the license, a business whose principal office is located in the foreign country, or a person who is a resident of the foreign country, if the holder of the certificate, license, or degree issued by the foreign country does not perform attest functions

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any action, evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter is sufficient to justify an injunction or a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: the firm shall take corrective action to comply with (i) of this section within a reasonable time after the noncompliance begins. The board shall establish by regulation the criteria to determine what is a reasonable time and may base the regulation on national standards.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: An individual licensed under AS 08.04.105 may not perform attest functions through a firm unless the firm holds a valid permit issued under AS 08.04.240.
